verdict.rationale: A hosted transcription API could plausibly offer a test or sandbox mode, so this axis applies. The evidence pack only documents transcription usage (file upload, CLI, the local pip package) and never mentions a sandbox, test mode, or isolated environment separate from production. Running the open-source model locally is a user-side arrangement, not a documented sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
